purpose: 新增 Longines IT 市場時，重新查核 data/traveler-refund-policies.json 既有的 IT 市場記錄（該記錄以 marketCode 為鍵、跨品牌共用）。本檔只記錄重新查核結果，未新增或修改政策記錄；格式比照 data/evidence/longines/DE/2026-09-27/traveler-refund-policy-check.json。

recheckQueries.publisher: Agenzia delle Dogane e dei Monopoli
recheckQueries.findings: 「individuals residing or having their domicile outside the EU」；「the value of purchased goods, (for each invoice) exceeds 70 euros ... VAT included」；「the goods leave the EU territory within three months following the date of issue of the invoice」；OTELLO 系統自動風險分析後導向綠色或紅色通道；「The refund is made directly by the Italian seller according to the terms agreed with the buyer」，退稅公司服務「could include the payment of a fee which is directly deducted from the amount of VAT refunded」。

conclusion: PASS：既有 IT 記錄（availability=available、需零售商參與、需出口核驗）與 2026-09-29 查得的官方來源一致，未發現差異，不需變更 data/traveler-refund-policies.json。
limitations: 僅重新查核市場級制度事實；未查證任何特定 Longines 精品店或經銷商實際是否提供退稅服務，既有記錄本身亦未作此主張。
